summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature as specified. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext classes, _make_reading_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads); tests/test_progress.py (13 new tests); docs/source/progress.rst (two new sections); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased/Added entry). Edits are additive, no ignore comments, no commit. Tests and code were not executed; verification was by reading only. Judgment calls: a getsize OSError is re-raised as ValueError chained from the original; readinto is implemented via read; write error message is "write is not supported by this reader"; the reader inherits BinaryIO and RawIOBase, whose mypy compatibility is unverified.
